from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_EVEN
import csv, io
billing='''record_id,quantity,unit_price,shipping
CUS-001,28,63.66,74
CUS-002,40,55.6,62
CUS-003,72,30.9,24
CUS-004,16,11.51,53
CUS-005,34,64.0,43
CUS-006,55,60.08,66
CUS-007,37,65.85,19
CUS-008,66,36.68,62
CUS-009,40,15.6,44
CUS-010,53,22.76,34
'''
disc=Decimal('0.0837'); tax=Decimal('0.0673')
rows=list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(billing)))
t=Decimal('0')
for r in rows:
    raw=Decimal(r['quantity'])*Decimal(r['unit_price'])*(Decimal(1)-disc)*(Decimal(1)+tax)+Decimal(r['shipping'])
    amt=raw.quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
    t+=amt
    print(r['record_id'], raw, amt)
print(len(rows),t)
PY

python3 - <<'PY'
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_EVEN
import csv, io
pay='''record_id,regular_hours,overtime_hours,hourly_rate,deduction
EMP-001,159,7,31.19,202
EMP-002,145,6,27.4,165
EMP-003,158,7,42.76,168
EMP-004,130,9,23.1,138
EMP-005,144,4,23.06,173
EMP-006,148,9,40.39,174
EMP-007,154,10,32.54,138
EMP-008,150,2,36.51,231
EMP-009,156,8,45.9,191
EMP-010,143,6,32.84,207
'''
D=Decimal; q=D('0.01'); m=D('1.73'); w=D('0.2137')
s1=D(0);s2=D(0)
for r in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(pay)):
    gross=D(r['regular_hours'])*D(r['hourly_rate'])+D(r['overtime_hours'])*D(r['hourly_rate'])*m
    gr=gross.quantize(q, rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
    net1=(gross*(1-w)-D(r['deduction'])).quantize(q,rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
    net2=(gr*(1-w)-D(r['deduction'])).quantize(q,rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
    print(r['record_id'], 'g',gross, gr,'net_unrg',net1,'net_rg',net2)
    s1+=net1;s2+=net2
print('totals',s1,s2)
PY

import csv, io

SUP-001,164,56.53,781
SUP-002,324,137.19,441
SUP-003,168,99.98,799
SUP-004,217,83.66,454

SUP-009,61,82.1,154
SUP-010,266,93.01,518
'''

total=Decimal('0')
for r in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(p)):
    raw=(Decimal(r['quantity'])*Decimal(r['unit_price'])+Decimal(r['freight']))*rate*(Decimal(1)+duty)
    rounded=raw.quantize(Decimal('.01'),rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
    total+=rounded
    print(r['record_id'], raw, rounded)
print(len(list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(p)))), total)
